forbidden_actor_inference: actor membership or generated position
why_illicit: Population frequency is not actor identity, membership, or probability; raw prevalence-to-weight conversion is forbidden absent separate authority
minimum_lawful_intermediate: separately governed position candidate/distribution rule -> ADP-009 actor-specific fact
ruling: Prevalence may describe a population field; it cannot pick the actor.

forbidden_actor_inference: actor propensity or likely belief
why_illicit: A population conditional has respondent risk-set semantics, not an actor causal transition or epistemic effect
minimum_lawful_intermediate: separate structural interpretation authority -> actor-specific developmental event/history -> owning response/epistemic rule
ruling: Conditional evidence may constrain world-side structure only after authority; it cannot become propensity.

population_or_structural_input: current attitude cloud / response cotravel / association score
forbidden_actor_inference: actor worldview, ideology bundle, or psyche
why_illicit: Population cotravel is a derived association view; D11 shows current cloud is not canonically propagated and D09 forbids psyche promotion
minimum_lawful_intermediate: lawful population meaning field -> separately governed structural interpretation -> developmental history -> epistemic authority
ruling: Cotravel can distinguish population contexts, never prove a person's worldview.

forbidden_actor_inference: actor has the joint configuration / belief bundle
why_illicit: Even governed joint packets are population evidence; V551J/V552J certification does not create actor membership
minimum_lawful_intermediate: bounded structural use -> V554/V555 possibility -> V3 generated history -> claim-specific epistemic effect
ruling: Joint evidence may affect bounded structure but not assign the actor's answers.

forbidden_actor_inference: actor belief, devotion, worldview, sect identity, or political allegiance
why_illicit: Shared label is not generated relation or epistemic stance; D10 finds no cross-ontology binding
minimum_lawful_intermediate: separately governed structural transformation/position generation plus actor-facing belief acquisition rule
ruling: Religion may condition population evidence or contextual structure only under separate authority.

forbidden_actor_inference: class position or class consciousness
why_illicit: Survey income/employment does not choose among material resource, labor relation, class relation, insecurity, or consciousness semantics
minimum_lawful_intermediate: governed contextual transformation -> generated class/material relation if authorized -> developmental epistemic history
ruling: Income can be empirical evidence; class and class consciousness require different authorities.

forbidden_actor_inference: class, sect, party, household, identity, or psyche
why_illicit: CAN-005 and ADP-009 explicitly forbid geography-to-position and geography-to-psyche inference
minimum_lawful_intermediate: exact geographic context; separately generated position facts where lawful
ruling: Geography can constrain context without manufacturing the actor.

forbidden_actor_inference: realized actor belief, response, orientation, wound, or attractor
why_illicit: Structural pressure is actor-independent world-side structure; CAN-008 forbids raw structure as response parent
minimum_lawful_intermediate: V554/V555/V558 bounded possibility -> generated/admitted V3 causal parent -> response/epistemic rule
ruling: Pressure can shape possibility fields, not directly write psyche.

forbidden_actor_inference: actual mediation or actual actor position
why_illicit: V554 F1 is DERIVED_STRUCTURAL_AFFORDANCE_NOT_RUNTIME_FACT; runtime requirements may be deferred but not asserted
minimum_lawful_intermediate: V555 route candidate and later V3 realization with exact actor bindings
ruling: Eligibility for mediation input is not lived mediation.

forbidden_actor_inference: actor traversed route / was exposed / transmitted / buffered / amplified
why_illicit: ADP-002 route has runtime_status NOT_INSTANTIATED and does not own encounter, traversal, response or history
minimum_lawful_intermediate: ADP-010 actor OEE plus accepted route-realization authority (ADP-011; missing at base)
ruling: Route availability is structural possibility only.

forbidden_actor_inference: actor interaction realization, prerequisite satisfaction, path dependence, wound, attractor, type
why_illicit: V556 architecture is actor-independent topology; concrete F1/F2 rule authority is incomplete at exact base and realization belongs V3
governing_negative_authority: V556 completion ruling; W3 launch; CAN-008
minimum_lawful_intermediate: accepted V556 rule -> later actor-specific realization/satisfaction authorities -> V3 history
ruling: Topology must not masquerade as actor state.

forbidden_actor_inference: actor biography, memory, belief, opportunity, encounter, exposure, or personality
why_illicit: Resolver selection is explicitly not actor event/experience and cannot infer generated position
minimum_lawful_intermediate: caller/V3-owned generated facts/events under exact authorities
ruling: V558 resolves; it does not invent.

forbidden_actor_inference: OPPORTUNITY
why_illicit: Availability is merely an addressable runtime basis; opportunity requires actor-specific basis/applicability and developmental state
minimum_lawful_intermediate: AVAILABLE parent + actor-specific opportunity rule/witness set
ruling: No automatic availability-to-opportunity promotion.

forbidden_actor_inference: ENCOUNTER
why_illicit: Opportunity is possibility, not occurrence; co-location/co-presence is insufficient
minimum_lawful_intermediate: active opportunity + exact independent contact witness
ruling: Opportunity may lawfully end with no encounter.

forbidden_actor_inference: EXPOSURE
why_illicit: Contact occurrence is not presentation/impingement; exposure requires a separate exact witness
minimum_lawful_intermediate: encounter parent + exact presentation/impingement witness
ruling: Encounter may lawfully end with no exposure.

forbidden_actor_inference: knowledge or belief
why_illicit: Exposure carries no awareness/absorption/epistemic semantics; knowledge/belief require exact actor-facing basis and owning rule
minimum_lawful_intermediate: generated actor-facing acquisition/recognition + canonical claim + owning epistemic effect
ruling: Exposure alone cannot write the actor's mind.

forbidden_actor_inference: memory
why_illicit: Event existence does not auto-form memory; memory is an optional typed causal effect with source-bound features
minimum_lawful_intermediate: eligible experiencer/causal basis + owning memory effect rule
ruling: An actor can live through an event without a formed declarative memory.

forbidden_actor_inference: knowledge, belief, recall, or first-person claim permission
why_illicit: Memory existence != current accessibility != epistemic stance != claim accessibility
minimum_lawful_intermediate: current memory-accessibility state plus exact epistemic/claim-accessibility rule
ruling: Memory may persist while inaccessible; belief may persist without current claim access.

forbidden_actor_inference: actor knowledge or recognition of error
why_illicit: Objective truth is necessary for KNOWLEDGE but not sufficient; analyst-only misrecognition does not create actor meta-knowledge
minimum_lawful_intermediate: actor-facing acquisition/recognition event + owning epistemic rule
ruling: The system may know what the actor does not.

forbidden_actor_inference: automatic actor response
why_illicit: CAN-008 requires an exact response rule and generated/admitted causal parent; exposure is not response
minimum_lawful_intermediate: generated/admitted parent + exact response rule -> atomic response transaction
ruling: Same exposure may yield no response or different lawful responses when different history/rules apply.

forbidden_actor_inference: V3 causal history, belief, memory, or relationship truth
why_illicit: V2 expresses generated life and session persistence is noncausal; rendering is not occurrence
minimum_lawful_intermediate: IN_WORLD_CAUSAL proposal -> V3 external-event admission; later causal effects separately governed
ruling: Presentation alone cannot back-write the actor.
